race.description: Sportsbet Race Replays C,G&E Mdn Plate
race.comment: SIR MONICA (9) is the top pick after resuming with a fifth at Morphettville, where he was slow away and raced keenly yet still gave enough to suggest this easier country assignment is within reach. Has placed several times around this trip and looks suited with that run under the belt. DANSEUR NOBLE (3) placed on debut at Warrnambool after travelling well and holding third, and natural improvement would put him right in the race. HELLENIC STAR (5) brings a solid last-start Gawler sixth, beaten just under three lengths after being bumped, and third-up fitness keeps him in the mix. CRAIG THE CLOWN (2) debuts with first-time blinkers and a recent Oakbank trial placing, so he is the unknown with enough readiness signals to be respected.
